values.note: Newaygo County '2026 Camping Fees' for Sandy Beach (one rate for everyone), Monday-Wednesday non-holiday / Thursday-Sunday: electric $28/$33, water and electric $33/$38, full hookup $46/$48, full-hookup pull-through water-view $43/$48; rustic $15/$20; cabin $74/$79. 21-day and seasonal rates for most site types (full hookup $3,050 a season). A county Motor Vehicle Permit is required for each day a vehicle is in the park: $8 a day, $24 for 3 days, $35 annual. $5 reservation fee; $25 cancellation fee.

fees.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('2026 Camping Fees', Sandy Beach County Park table, 'Reservation fee (Applies to all reservations) – $5.00', 'A valid Newaygo County Motor Vehicle Permit is required for each day a vehicle is in the park', 'Daily MVP- $8'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online through the county's FireFly Reservations page, or by phone (231-689-7340, or the campground in season). Online bookings need 2 nights; a 1-night stay is booked by calling the park, so the 2-night minimum is not recorded as a rule. 2026 reservations opened January 5 at 9 a.m.; paid in full at booking. Holiday bookings are non-refundable.

booking.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('All campsite and cabin reservations require a 2-night minimum (3 nights on holidays)', 'For 1-night reservations, you must call your Park of choice for a reservation', '2026 Reservations Begin Online January 5th, 2026') + park-reservations/ ('With our online system FireFly Reservations') + sandy-beach-park/ ('Click here to make Park Reservation Online' -> app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/SBCountyPark), read 2026-10-22

note: Newaygo County park on Hardy Dam Pond (6926 E 30th St, White Cloud): full-hookup, water/electric, electric and rustic sites plus cabins; beach, dog park, boat launch/marina, trails. Seasonal sites offered. Consumers Energy lowers the pond from November 1 until the Friday before Memorial Day, so the docks and launch open then. --Claude
summary: County's park and 2026 rates pages: $28 (electric, Mon-Wed) to $48 (full hookup / water-view pull-through, Thu-Sun) - changed 25-41 -> 28-48; $5 reservation fee; $8/day vehicle permit recorded as entrance; season May 1-Oct 11; FireFly online booking (2-night online minimum, 1-night by phone, 3 nights on holidays); full hookups, pull-throughs, sanitation station. Amperage (50A, note prose) not stated, left. Note cleaned of the hookup and season text the fields hold; pond draw-down caveat added.
flags: Website is the county parks index (https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/parks-recreation/); the park's own page is https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/sandy-beach-park/ (booking https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/SBCountyPark).
Phone: the entry's (231) 689-7340 is the county parks office (off-season contact); the campground's in-season number is (231) 689-1229.
Waterfront re-audit lead: the county sells 'Campsite (Full-hookup, Pull-thru, Water View)' sites; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
